description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that implements scrollbar annotations, allowing visual markers to be displayed on the scrollbar for code annotations or highlights.

classes.name: Annotation
classes.description: A class managing scrollbar annotations, including rendering, updating, and clearing annotation markers.

methods.name: computeScale
methods.description: Calculates the scale factor for scrollbar annotations based on the current editor size.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current annotations and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Redraws the scrollbar annotations based on current annotations and editor state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all event listeners and DOM elements associated with the scrollbar annotations.
